project_type: React SPA (Propela Ops - internal operations platform for Propela Health)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install 2. Run npm run build - confirm no errors 3. Run npm run dev to check the app loads 4. Verify routing works for all modules
setup_instructions: npm install in the project root (app lives in /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform/)
environment_constraints: Standard sandbox with internet access. Node.js available. npm install works.
contribution_requirements: Branch: stage-1-and-2-rebuild. No push - orchestrator handles that.
key_patterns: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4. React Router for module routing. localStorage for persistence (Phase 1 single user). Propela purple #5B2D8E as primary brand color. Poppins font. Design reference JSX components in design-reference/Propela Ops/components/ show the visual language. Lucide React for icons. The PRD specifies 5 modules: Dashboard, Nurse Database, Nurse Acquisition Hub, Cohort Manager, Outreach Log + Template Library.
directory_structure: Root: /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform/. Currently only has design-reference/ folder. The React app will be created at root level (package.json, src/, public/, etc.)
